decks.notes: The deck revolves around using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells such as Emergent Ultimatum, Omniscience, and Dark Petition. The deck uses various cards like Hidden Strings, Voyaging Satyr, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field and generate even more mana. By tutoring for key combo pieces and casting game-changing spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on using Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures into play, such as Mirrex and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes Warping Wail for versatility and Tribute to Horobi for additional removal options. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the battlefield to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate a powerful engine that overwhelms the opponent. It uses cards like Grisly Salvage and Satyr Wayfinder to quickly fill the graveyard, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also includes cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to provide additional threats and value. The mana base is optimized to support the combo pieces and ensure consistent mana production.

Utilizing a combination of Indomitable Creativity and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this deck focuses on quickly summoning powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels to overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of cards like Spikefield Hazard and Make Disappear helps control the board while maintaining a creative edge. With supporting spells like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse and Dig Through Time, this deck offers a unique and resourceful approach to combo play, showcasing the potential for explosive and unexpected victories.

This Pioneer Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and graveyard while maintaining control over the board with removal spells and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil. The deck utilizes cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Go Blank to strip the opponent's hand, while also gaining value from Waste Not and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The end game of the deck involves overwhelming the opponent with threats like Tergrid, God of Fright and The Meathook Massacre, all while controlling the board with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by consistently countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage. It utilizes a variety of instant speed removal spells like Fatal Push and Sinister Sabotage, along with counterspells such as Negate to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also has powerful card draw engines like Dig Through Time and Memory Deluge to ensure it has access to its key cards. Additionally, the deck includes various win conditions such as Shark Typhoon and Hullbreaker Horror to close out the game once it has stabilized the board.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while maximizing green devotion. The deck aims to play big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Karn, the Great Creator, and Old-Growth Troll early in the game to apply pressure and overwhelm the opponent. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to untap mana dorks for extra mana acceleration. The deck also includes some versatile utility cards like Storm the Festival and Boseiju, Who Endures to enhance its aggro strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, allowing for the casting of powerful green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional versatility and control options, while Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps to draw cards and untap potential mana sources. Storm the Festival and Wrenn and Realmbreaker offer additional value and threats, creating an aggressive and efficient strategy focused on overwhelming the opponent with powerful green creatures and abilities.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It aims to efficiently deal with threats using cards like Portable Hole and Supreme Verdict, while also generating card advantage with spells like Memory Deluge. The deck also includes finishers like Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants to close out the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the board, disrupting opponents' plans, and ultimately out-valuing them in the long game.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to turn a creature token into a powerful creature from the library, while also utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to create additional tokens and control the board. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to deal with threats, as well as a companion card in Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional mana ramp. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures.

This deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent using a variety of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent, forcing them to react defensively while you continue to push for damage. With a strong mix of cheap and powerful creatures, as well as burn spells that can be cast for their alternate cost, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through card advantage and removal spells while utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to transform small creatures and enchantments into more powerful threats. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and generate value over time, ultimately overwhelming them with powerful creatures and enchantments. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value and flexibility, ensuring that the deck maintains a strong board presence and answers to various threats. By carefully curating its resources and utilizing its synergies effectively, the deck can outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. The deck also includes a variety of spells and abilities to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal like Fiery Impulse. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and explosive plays.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Dovin's Veto, and Supreme Verdict to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck. The deck also includes cards like Omen of the Sea and Shark Typhoon for card draw and token generation, as well as various land destruction and counterspell effects to consistently control the game. Ultimately, the goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cheap spells and card draw to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, which can be easily brought back for devastating attacks. The deck includes a mix of burn spells, card draw, and Phoenix enablers to maintain pressure on the opponent while cycling through the deck. The addition of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass allows for massive card advantage and potential game-ending plays. Efficiently managing resources while steadily bringing back Phoenixes is crucial to the success of this aggressive strategy.

The main theme of this deck revolves around ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also utilizing green devotion cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll to overpower opponents quickly. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provides additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and overwhelm opponents with powerful green creatures and spells. Additionally, the deck includes some versatile cards like Oath of Nissa and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to provide flexibility in different situations.
